notes: ACCESS: tier (a) direct HTTP fetch via curl_cffi (chrome124 impersonation) got 403 Access Denied (Akamai edgesuite.net wall) on both the target URL and robots.txt. Tier (b) Playwright/Chromium headless also got 403 Access Denied on the same URL and on robots.txt (robots.txt itself is blocked to automated clients so no Claude-bot-specific Disallow could be confirmed either way). Escalated to tier (c) Claude-in-Chrome (real logged-in browser session), which loaded the site normally (200, full DOM) - used for the entire research pass. Cookie consent banner was dismissed via 'Reject all' (privacy-preserving choice). TREE METHOD: explored via mega-menu hover (Home & Lifestyle), then walked each department's own left-sidebar category-filter list (Home Furnishings, Bedding, Bathroom, Dining, Kitchenware, Home Accessories, Furniture) using read_page/find on the rendered DOM; each leaf visited directly and confirmed by page <title>/h1 matching the requested node (caught one bad-slug case where a stale sidebar was returned before hydration completed - resolved by re-navigating and waiting). QTY METHOD: exact 'Category Name (N)' count text from the sidebar category-filter link on each leaf's own listing page (Harrods renders an exact product count per category node). EXCLUDED: Furniture > Storage & Shelving (34) with children Sideboards (14) and Cabinets & Safes (11) - both are furniture case-goods explicitly nested under the Furniture department; per storage.md Storage Furniture Boundary 'if the website explicitly places the product inside a Furniture category, prefer Furniture' - dropped as an orphaned parent (no storage.md-qualifying leaf remained). Kitchen Storage > Water Bottles & Travel Mugs (167) excluded - drinkware, Kitchen & Dining scope, not storage/organization. Outdoor section (Furniture/Cooking & Dining/Accessories) has no dedicated textile or storage subcategory (mixed candles/lamps/cooler-box listing) - not recorded per parent-URL rule. Home Accessories has no dedicated storage node besides Jewellery & Watch Boxes (included, see flags). No ready-made Curtains category found anywhere in the nav/sidebars (site search UI did not render a usable input box after several attempts; relied on exhaustive nav/sidebar walk instead) - Harrods appears not to carry a distinct curtains listing. Bathroom Storage's four children (Holders, Soap Dispensers, Tissue Boxes, Bathroom Bins) are all nested under a category the site itself literally names 'Bathroom Storage', but product samples shown (Pedal Bin, Soap Dispenser, gold-plated Trolley) suggest several are bathroom accessories/waste-bins rather than genuine organizational storage - included per site hierarchy per storage.md ambiguity-resolution order but flagged LOW/MEDIUM for manual review. Jewellery & Watch Boxes sits under generic 'Home Accessories' (decor), not a dedicated storage section, but the product's primary function is storage per storage.md rule 7 (Jewellery Organizers) - included MEDIUM. Placemats & Coasters and Napkins & Napkin Rings are combined nodes (rings/coasters are not fabric) nested inside the explicitly-textile 'Table Linens' parent - included MEDIUM per website hierarchy, since the site does not offer a further split.
